title: Siman 275
section: The Greatness and Awesomeness of His Attainments

segments.he: אַחַרשֶׁאָמַר הַתּוֹרָה בְּטַח בַּה' וַעֲשֵׂה טוֹב בְּסִימָן ע"ט בְּלִקּוּטֵי א' הָיָה הוֹלֵךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ אָנֶה וָאָנָה כְּדַרְכּוֹ
segments.en: (35.) "The world think that when Messiah comes they will not die — this is not so. Even Messiah himself will also die." And he said this publicly.
